evidence.snippet: Suciati et al. isolated kendomycin B from Streptomyces sp. and demonstrated potent antibacterial activity against Gram-positive bacteria and Mycobacteria alongside kendomycin A.

evidence.snippet: Iwasa et al. isolated the peptidyl nucleoside antibiotic amipurimycin from Streptomyces novoguineensis sp. nov. and demonstrated potent curative and protective antifungal activity against Pyricularia oryzae (rice blast) and phytopathogenic fungi.
evidence.notes: Iwasa et al. 1977 (J Antibiot 30:1-10; PMID:557042) discovered amipurimycin from Streptomyces novoguineensis T-36496 and characterized its antifungal spectrum against Pyricularia oryzae, Cochliobolus miyabeanus, and Alternaria kikuchiana.

after_fields.mode_of_action_notes: CURATOR: Synthetic para-aminobenzenesulfonamide antimicrobial (sulfacetamide) that acts as a competitive structural analog of para-aminobenzoic acid (PABA) at the active site of bacterial dihydropteroate synthase (FolP / DHPS, EC 2.5.1.15), forming dead-end pterin-sulfa adducts and blocking de novo dihydropteroate and tetrahydrofolate biosynthesis (Roland et al. 1979, DOI:10.1128/AAC.15.2.195, PMID:378102; Yun et al. 2012, DOI:10.1126/science.1214641, PMID:22383845).

before_molecular_targets.experimental_context: CARD/ARO database assertion; target organism, strain, and assay are not specified. Dihydropteroate synthase is asserted as the inhibited enzyme.

evidence.notes: CARD/ARO asserts targeted_by_antibiotic ARO:3000683 (sulfacetamide); database assertion, not a primary citation.

after_molecular_targets.experimental_context: CARD/ARO database assertion; target organism, strain, and assay are not specified. Dihydropteroate synthase is asserted as the inhibited enzyme.

evidence.notes: CARD/ARO asserts targeted_by_antibiotic ARO:3000683 (sulfacetamide); database assertion, not a primary citation.

after_molecular_targets.experimental_context: Purified Escherichia coli dihydropteroate synthase (FolP / DHPS) cell-free enzyme inhibition (I50) and PABA competitive kinetics alongside structural and biochemical characterization of pterin-sulfonamide dead-end adduct formation in bacterial DHPS for sulfacetamide and comparator sulfonamides (Roland et al. 1979, DOI:10.1128/AAC.15.2.195, PMID:378102; Yun et al. 2012, DOI:10.1126/science.1214641, PMID:22383845).

evidence.snippet: Roland et al. quantified the cell-free inhibition (I50) of purified Escherichia coli dihydropteroate synthase by 27 sulfonamides and correlated competitive DHPS enzyme inhibition with whole-cell antibacterial MICs.
evidence.notes: Roland et al. 1979 (Antimicrob Agents Chemother 15:195-197; PMID:378102) measured direct inhibition of purified Escherichia coli dihydropteroate synthase (FolP / DHPS) by sulfacetamide and comparator sulfonamides.

Yun et al. 2012 (Science 335:1110-1114; PMID:22383845) resolved the structural and catalytic mechanism of sulfonamide binding at the PABA site of bacterial dihydropteroate synthase (DHPS / FolP), demonstrating pterin-sulfa adduct catalysis and sulfonamide-resistance loop mutations.
